name: UQ emergency hardship grant
summary: A one-off grant for urgent, unexpected costs that are affecting your study at UQ.
who: Current UQ students who have finished a semester of full-time study, or are past the census date of their first semester.
Facing a temporary, unexpected financial need, and able to complete their program.
numbers: Rent or bond, bills, public transport, study equipment, medical costs, basic furniture, crisis relocation, and school or childcare costs
Tuition, SSAF, fines, holidays, credit cards, visa fees or OSHC
need: UQ student ID plus a driver's licence, Medicare card or passport.
At least 2 payslips or a current Centrelink income statement.
Official bank statements for the past 3 months. Screenshots aren't accepted.
A quote, invoice or bill for what you need help with.
how: Submit the online application with your documents.
Meet an Accessibility and Welfare Adviser in person or on Zoom.
You'll usually hear within 5 business days of the meeting.
catches: It isn't ongoing support. UQ also has a separate Laptop Grant for broken laptops.
